If your visitor visa expired in canada​ or visitor record has expired while you are still in Canada, you must act quickly. IRCC allows eligible individuals to apply for restoration of status, but the process is time-sensitive. Failure to restore your status can lead to loss of legal status, removal orders, and long-term immigration consequences.
